title: Survival crafter game update: Motion blur & new shaders
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
Using new motion blur and shader capabilities for my survival crafter game - really happy with the atmosphere of the game right now but not sure if the motion blur too much?

  
This is an update to the Wyrmwood game I posted about here in my original post: [https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1uozuvs/comment/ovyb06k/?screen\_view\_count=5](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1uozuvs/comment/ovyb06k/?screen_view_count=5)

comments.author: haven_fr
comments.body: motion blur is a big no

comments.author: aberroco
